name: US Tech Deals & Price Checker
tagline: Tells you whether a US gadget price is actually a decent buy
description: Give it a gadget listing and it answers the practical question: is this price actually good? It cross-checks verified US deal listings, adds price-history context so you can see whether a discount is real, and looks up live coupons before you buy. The maintainer discloses affiliate commissions on purchases.
author: moneydeals123
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
